t_advice_summary_textbox.text: You will see two types of gnomes that will lead you to two different forests, to get the most amount of mushrooms (points) you must try to remember which colour gnome took you to the forest with the most mushrooms.There are multiple colour gnomes.

vb_textbox.text: One gnome will take you to a forest with a red basket, the other will take you to a forest with a yellow basket.The amount of mushrooms in each forest will change over time so you must try to remember which colour gnome takes you to the coloured basket that has the most amount of mushrooms in that forest.Each gnome does not change the colour of their basket, remember the colour of the gnome and you will find the basket colour you need.
